column1: # Campaign 25 source evidence for bounded configured two-relation binding.

column5: ConfiguredRelationTree binds exactly two configured base tables, alias-visible direct projections, and source-owned signed-BIGINT comparisons before runtime while retaining ON or USING for typed join planning; general PlanBuilder statements, subqueries, derived tables, CTEs, aggregation, outer or semi joins, more relations, and non-BIGINT expressions remain open.

The bounded relation tree preserves left/right source identity, projection order, and local predicate ownership for INNER, CROSS, and comma syntax; logical optimization, predicate derivation, outer-join simplification, join reorder, statistics, and physical implementation selection remain open.
